english.note: Use this for a storey or level of a building, as in the third floor.

exampleSentences.english: Our company is on the tenth floor.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 sap6 lau4

english.note: Use 樓 as the everyday spoken noun for a floor or storey of a building.

exampleSentences.english: My room is on level five.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong2 hai2 ng5 lau4
